description: Inventory of every third-party native file this package redistributes: upstream version, licence and SHA-256. tools/Test-NativeManifest.ps1 checks it against the files on disk before release packing.

components.name: MoltenVK
components.supplier: The Khronos Group (originally The Brenwill Workshop Ltd.)
components.provenance: libMoltenVK.dylib (a universal x86_64 + arm64 Mach-O binary, so the osx-x64 and osx-arm64 copies are identical) and MoltenVK_icd.json are byte-identical to MoltenVK/dynamic/dylib/macOS/ in the upstream v1.4.1 release archive (SHA-256 compared 2026-10-28).

files.note: Same bytes as libMoltenVK.dylib, installed under the Vulkan loader's library name so a Vulkan-loader lookup resolves to MoltenVK. It is not the Khronos Vulkan loader.
